s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive ataxia with spasms and myoclonus
key_facts: Difficulty with gait progressed after cessation of alcohol use
Throat spasms do not affect speech or eating
Normal genetic testing for spinocerebellar ataxia types 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12
Severe cerebral and cerebellar atrophy on MRI brain without contrast

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive ataxia with spasms and myoclonus
key_facts: Difficulty with gait progressed after cessation of alcohol use
Throat spasms do not affect speech or eating
Normal genetic testing for spinocerebellar ataxia types 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12
Severe cerebral and cerebellar atrophy on MRI brain without contrast

shortlist.label: Multiple system atrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive ataxia, autonomic dysfunction, and parkinsonian features

shortlist.label: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 7
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive ataxia and severe cerebral and cerebellar atrophy

shortlist.label: Palatal myoclonus syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Palatal myoclonus at 1-2 Hz, consistent with this rare condition

shortlist.label: Dentatorubral-pallidoluysian atrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive ataxia, myoclonus, and severe cerebral atrophy

shortlist.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly progressive ataxia and myoclonus, although less likely given the 20-year history

raw.rationale: The combination of progressive ataxia, autonomic dysfunction, and parkinsonism (bradykinesia and mild rigidity) suggests a diagnosis of multiple system atrophy, which is further supported by the presence of severe cerebral and cerebellar atrophy on MRI.
raw.anchor_refutation: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 7 is refuted because the patient's genetic testing for this condition was normal, and the clinical presentation includes features such as bradykinesia and mild rigidity that are not typical of spinocerebellar ataxia type 7.

rejected.label: Palatal myoclonus syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of other characteristic features such as clicking sounds

rejected.label: Dentatorubral-pallidoluysian atrophy
rejected.why: Insufficient evidence of characteristic features such as choreoathetosis

rejected.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
rejected.why: Lack of rapid cognitive decline and myoclonus affecting other parts of the body
